test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The crew/ of sailors/ were not perturbed/ by the strong gale.
solution:
The erroneous part is **'were not perturbed'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here,** 'was not perturbed'** should be used instead of **'were not perturbed'.**
 
• In the given sentence **'the crew of sailors' **is** a collective noun.**
 
• If the** collective noun refers **to the group as a unit, then it takes **a singular verb**. If it refers to the **individuals in the group or the parts** that make up the group, then the **verb** should be **plural**. 
 
• In the given sentence the **collective noun** is **referring** to **a single group.**
 
 
• *Exaple: A huge swarm of locusts has destroyed the crops.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *The crew of sailors **was not perturbed **by the strong gale.*
